goal:
Execution counts that feed GH_INTEGRITY must come from a server-side run, not from the client (CR-62/74, D-050). Hackathon Runner = local subprocess in a hygiene sandbox (NOT a microVM; say so in the module docstring).
1. New module services/api/evoforge/runner.py:
   - class RunnerError(ValueError).
   - allowed_repo(source_repo: str) -> str: refuse URLs and remote specs (anything containing '://', starting with 'git@', 'file:' or '-'); the path must be an existing directory containing .git and must lie inside one of the roots listed in env EVO_REPO_ROOTS (os.pathsep-separated). Compare real paths with os.path.commonpath (case-insensitive on Windows) so that a sibling like <root>2/repo is NOT inside <root>. EVO_REPO_ROOTS unset or empty -> refuse everything. Return the resolved path. All refusals raise RunnerError.
   - run_candidate(source_repo, base_sha, diff, visible_tests, heldout_tests, timeout_s=120, future_shas=None) -> dict:
     a) allowed_repo; build a fresh sandbox with eval_hygiene.build_sandbox_repo(source, base_sha, dest) (dest must not exist yet); violations = eval_hygiene.audit(dest, base, future_shas or []); any violation -> RunnerError.
     b) apply `diff` unless it is empty/whitespace: every path from evoforge.patch.paths_in_diff must be relative, contain no '..', not be under '.git', and resolve inside the sandbox, else RunnerError; read current texts (None if absent), evoforge.patch.apply_unified_diff (PatchError propagates unchanged), write results with newline='' (delete for None).
     c) every test entry must be a dict whose 'code' is a non-empty str, else RunnerError. Write visible tests to <sandbox>/.evoforge_run/visible/test_visible_<i>.py and held-out tests to <sandbox>/.evoforge_run/heldout/test_heldout_<i>.py (i starts at 1).
     d) run each non-empty suite with [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '--rootdir', sandbox, '--junitxml', <xml outside the suite dir>, <suite dir>], cwd=sandbox, timeout=timeout_s, and a SCRUBBED env containing only PATH, SYSTEMROOT, WINDIR, TEMP, TMP, HOME, USERPROFILE, LANG (when present) plus PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONPATH=<sandbox>. No other variable (MODEL_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, DATABASE_URL, ...) may reach the tests.
     e) counts from the junit xml: n = number of <testcase> elements; pass = testcases with no <failure>, <error> or <skipped> child (a skipped test is NOT a pass). Missing or unparseable xml -> n = number of snippets in that suite, pass = 0. Timeout -> pass = 0, n = number of snippets, timed_out = True. An empty suite -> n = 0, pass = 0.
     f) return {"base": <resolved base sha>, "hygiene": [], "visible": {"pass", "n", "timed_out", "exit_code"}, "heldout": {same keys}, "heldout_kinds": [str(t.get('kind', '')) for t in heldout_tests]}. Never include held-out test code in the result.
     g) always delete the sandbox afterwards, also on errors (on Windows clear read-only bits of git objects before removing).
2. services/api/main.py:
   - POST /v1/runs body {source_repo: str, base_sha: str, diff: str = '', tests: list[dict] = [], heldout_tests: list[dict] = [], timeout_s: int = Field(120, ge=1, le=600)}. Call run_candidate resolved from module evoforge.runner AT CALL TIME. RunnerError -> 400, PatchError -> 409. Then gates = evaluate_full(diff, tests, [k for k in run['heldout_kinds'] if k], visible.pass, visible.n, heldout.pass, heldout.n). Store evidence {"diff", "tests", "gates", "run", "source_repo", "base_sha"} (no held-out code anywhere) and return {"gates", "run", "evidence_id"}.
   - POST /v1/pr/create: the source evidence must ALSO carry a server "run" record; evidence produced by /v1/gates/evaluate (client-reported counts) -> 409 with a detail containing "no server run". Everything else in pr_create stays as is.
   - POST /v1/eval/sandbox: source_repo must pass runner.allowed_repo (RunnerError -> 400) before anything is cloned.
